name: Buoyancy (Frog God Games)
body:
School transmutation [water]; Level cleric/oracle 1, druid 1, sorcerer/wizard 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (a small white ring)

EFFECT

Range touch
Target one creature touched
Duration 10 minutes/level
Saving Throw Fortitude (harmless); Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

Normally cast upon a drowning companion, buoyancy causes the target to become lighter than the surrounding liquid. The target either rises to the surface of any surrounding water (at a rate of 10 feet per round) or floats on the surface of the water regardless of encumbrance or armor.

The target is in no way granted any additional mobility or breathing benefits while in the water. This spell only keeps the subject from sinking.
